## Install
Download **NotchBar-x.y.z.dmg** below, open it and drag **NotchBar** onto **Applications**. Then open NotchBar from Applications.

Or with Homebrew: `brew install --cask rikenpatel02/tap/notchbar`

Or install or update from Terminal:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rikenpatel02/notchbar/main/install.sh | bash
```

NotchBar is signed with a Developer ID and notarized by Apple. Requires macOS 13 or later, on Apple Silicon or Intel.

On first launch, a setup window walks you through connecting Claude Code, Open at login and Terminal tab jumping.
